next_step.title: Sam's ASE naming reply, then his Another look saves
next_step.text: On ASE short, change the sweep's ASE rule. Then read his unified_title_supersedes and title_sweep_kept rows and the next fold's revise receipt, and move the panel rows it lists. Watch the first rule sent to the routine.

changes.text: Funding review rows: Follow up beside Accept and Deny on a waiting request, an editable email to the requester with the CO Monitor's note (#2627).

The Exhibits tab's Rules view: every rule that suggests or folds a title, with who set it and what it did, and Send to the routine, which the CPL queue routine builds switched off for Turn on or Discard (#2626).
A conflict card saves over a person-reviewed title the way Another look does; the issuer and site boxes offer the reference's names (#2625).

Another look in the Exhibits tab: a nightly sweep through every title for what still differs (ASE test, Arabic numerals, language level, a course number, a level, a fold), 134 cards; Change applies at the fold only while the replaced title stands (#2623).

The Exhibits review card: Change to Proposed Title first, the local title in bold, Back to this visit's earlier cards (a new choice replaces the save), and Accept all proposed titles, which leaves conflicts and earlier saves as they are (#2620).
The AP fold in the reference: 77 local titles under College Board's official names, 42 saved assignments moved to match (#2617).
The IT/AI catalog's MAP join needs the issuer to agree and reads the hand check (#2615).
Sam's AP rule in brand-family: an AP title takes College Board's official exam name; 18 of the 23 AP titles waiting settle (#2614).
The Credential Catalog's Worth a faculty review: 28 Credential Engine credentials MAP has no exhibit for (#2613); the catalog's MAP join needs the issuer to agree (#2615).
The Commons' CER row opens the Exhibits tab (#2612).
